purpose: Teach: 加地/今春/新選/正門/Ａ子/坂井/当地/親方

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、ご友人の加地さんとお茶されてたよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: Aoi, that customer—Kaji-san, wasn't it?—was having tea with a friend.
lines.style: Warm, conversational. Gentle recall, like sharing a small observation. Soft smile in the voice. Even pacing, intimate—the tone of someone telling a close friend something she noticed.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、「今春から本格的にお店を始める」って仰ってたよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: Aoi, that customer mentioned she's going to open a proper shop starting this spring.
lines.style: Thoughtful, measured delivery. The emphasis lands on 'this spring'—significant, a real plan. Quiet wonder underneath, like she's processing something meaningful she overheard.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、新選組ファンクラブの会員だって、メイちゃん
lines.en: Aoi, that customer is apparently a member of the Shinsengumi fan club.
lines.style: Gentle amusement in the voice, no mockery. A small, knowing smile. Soft—the kind of detail that delights her because it reveals something unexpected about someone.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、学校の正門前で待ち合わせされてたよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: Aoi, that customer was meeting a friend at the school's front gate.
lines.style: Quiet, factual but warm. Like noting a small piece of someone's life. Even pace, no urgency—just the gentle accumulation of noticing.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、小説でＡ子と書かれた登場人物に共感されてたよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: Aoi, that customer really connected with the character A-ko in the novel she was reading.
lines.style: Soft recognition in the voice. A-ko lands with gentle weight. Tender underneath—she understands what it means to find yourself in a character.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、ご友人の坂井さんと音楽鑑賞されてたよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: Aoi, that customer was listening to music with a friend—Sakai-san, I think.
lines.style: Gentle, almost dreamy recall. Conversational, warm. The kind of small detail she holds and shares because it matters somehow.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、「当地の郷土料理を作ってきた」って仰ってたよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: Aoi, that customer mentioned she'd brought local home cooking from her region.
lines.style: Quiet delight in the voice. The words land with the warmth of home—she appreciates the care in bringing something made with hands. Soft finish.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、相撲の親方のお話を熱心に語って下さったよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: Aoi, that customer spoke quite passionately about a sumo master's story.
lines.style: Warm and appreciative. The word 'passionately' carries a small smile—she noticed the energy, the care in his telling. Slight fade at the end, like she's lingering on the image.
